criteria.criterion: Core loop deterministic under a fixed seed
Every proposal carries reason, confidence, preconditions, postconditions, timeout/recovery
criteria.note: Fields exist on ActionProposal; most policy branches leave preconditions and expected empty, and there is no timeout field at all

criteria.criterion: Unknown or contradictory observations fail closed
criteria.note: Invariant blocks irreversible proposals from UNKNOWN, but counters still advance on sub-threshold frames — see defect D1

criteria.criterion: Shiny implies alert event, proof request, terminal halt
criteria.note: Alert and halt work (replay-verified). Proof capture is only prose in expected_postconditions; no artifact is requested or written

criteria.criterion: Normal encounters never take the shiny branch in the labeled corpus
criteria.note: No labeled corpus exists; corpus/ holds only a README

criteria.criterion: Scenario behavior data-driven, not copied into scripts
criteria.note: Thresholds, species, and simulator settings load from the manifest, but branch logic is hard-coded in FishingPolicy, and allowed_sources plus terminal_conditions are parsed by nobody
JsonlEventStore appends observation/belief/proposal/sink events; no reader reconstructs a session from them

criteria.criterion: Replays rerun after code changes to detect regressions
criteria.note: No regression runner, and fixtures carry no expected-transition labels to compare against

criteria.criterion: Read-only API emits phase, counts, confidence, rate, resources, halt reason
criteria.note: Phase, counts, confidence, and halt reason are present. Missing: encounters-per-hour, resource estimates, last-progress age, warnings

criteria.criterion: Tests cover the eleven named failure modes
criteria.note: 8 tests. Untested: no-bite loops, missed hooks, non-target encounters, resource exhaustion, low-confidence frames, contradictory frames, duplicate/stale frames, long stalls

criteria.criterion: Guard rejects live-control packages and symbols
criteria.note: Guard passes clean; rejection proven by test_guard_rejects_forbidden_import

criteria.criterion: Install, tests, simulation, replay, overlay run from a clean environment
criteria.note: First four verified above; overlay UNVERIFIED
README.md describes an OBS HTML view built on the status endpoint; the served page exists but omits the metrics required by criterion 9

defects.title: Sub-threshold observations still increment encounter counters
Contradiction detection is one hard-coded pair
Policy mutates belief state while deciding
No proof artifact on the shiny branch

gates.gate: Magikarp fixture and simulator tests pass from a clean checkout
Branch and mutation tests demonstrate fail-closed behavior
A new scenario needs only a manifest and fixtures, no control-flow code
Thousands of seeded sessions with confidence intervals
Model changes accepted only on replay-metric improvement
Viewer can always distinguish simulation, replay, offline, and manual
